comparison.objective: Use a hoist pendant while steering a suspended motor onto four base studs; candidate commissions a compact damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual pendant operation, pendulum-load control, multi-stud alignment, and controlled lowering versus fine tool/collar manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: All studs through, feet flat, chain slack, and no under-load, pinch, or high-speed strike violation; candidate uses damper travel and response limits.
comparison.reason: Hoisted-load alignment and safety-zone control test a substantially different capability.
